theme: Nautical peril meets theatrical drama under a blood‑red sky
global_event: The Crimson Tide – a mysterious wave turns the sea red and unsettles both sailors and singers
narrative_steps: A single drop of crimson water drips from a sailor’s beard.
A torn opera programme floats on the red waves.
A whisky bottle, half‑empty, washed ashore.
An ear trumpet lies abandoned on the deck.
A paw print in the red sand.
The diva's lost diamond glints in the moonlight.
A cutlass stuck in the mast, reflecting the red sky.
The ship’s wheel spins wildly, unmanned.
A white quiff emerges from the crimson tide – Tintin returns.
